description: Dismisses the shared-line review hint between two contacts (they share a phone or email but are different people), or removes a Related people link from the card, as Keep separate and Remove link do. relationshipId comes from read (the relationship is returned by the card's relationships read). The pair is recorded as different people first, so Sergio never combines them on its own; both stay separate contacts. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat after the edge is gone answers not found.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: dismiss_client_relationship
title: Keep two contacts separate, or remove a Related link
